title: Simple Variable Mass 6DOF (Euler Angles)
text: Implement Euler angle representation of six-degrees-of-freedom equations of motion of simple variable mass, 4 inputs, 10 outputs, {Mass type} sets Mass type Simple; {Units} sets the input and output units Metric, {Representation} sets the equations of motion representation Euler, {Initial position in inertial axes [Xe,Ye,Ze]} sets the position in inertial axes, {Initial velocity in body axes [U,v,w]} sets the velocity in body axes, {Initial Euler orientation [roll, pitch, yaw]} sets the initial Euler orientation, {Initial body rotation rates [p,q,r]} sets the initial body rotation, {Initial mass}, {Empty mass}, {Full mass}, {Empty inertia}, {Full inertia}, {Include mass flow relative velocity} sets the mass flow relative velocity port, {Output mass properties for acceleration computation} sets the include mass properties for acceleration, {Position: e.g., ’Xe’,’Ye’,’Ze’} sets the position state name, {Velocity: e.g., ’U’,’v’,’w’} sets the velocity state name, {Euler rotation angles: e.g., ’phi’,’theta’,’psi’} sets the euler rotation state name, {Body rotation rates: e.g., ’p’,’q’,’r’} sets the body rotation state names and {Mass: e.g., ’mass’} sets the mass state name. Values come from the instance.
